claims.access_scope: Indexed primary-article passages about L-DOPA and crystallographic preparation; direct PMC fetch blocked and Europe PMC full-text API returned 404. No full-text or assay-data audit.
claims.claim: RsTAL is reported to act on L-DOPA, but the authors explicitly state that these activity data are not shown. Caffeate complexes were prepared by soaking crystals in product-containing solution.
claims.boundary: Product binding is not turnover evidence. No L-DOPA kinetic constants, reverse activity, or Cannabis activity established here.

claims.claim: The caffeate-bound RsTAL structure is associated with the same publication. Protein numbering and construct sequence must be aligned before transferring residue positions to UniProt or Cannabis proteins.
